system.note: Set to the model actually used in demos; rule_handled reflects the number of inbox items handled by the rule path during a real R1 run.

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: every message gets one disposition + reason, none left
capabilities.observable: All 100 messages receive exactly one disposition and one reason; no message remains unclassified.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: drafts cite the earlier message they used (m008 ← m003)
capabilities.observable: The drafted reply to m008 grounds its content in the earlier m003 message and cites the relevant facts.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.observable: Any irreversible action is blocked unless approval is granted or the dry-run flag is active.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: m015 / m041 survive a restart and change later mail
capabilities.observable: The preference extracted from m015 and the owner note in m041 persist on disk and affect later mail after a restart.

evidence.effect: Later messages are handled according to saved preference rules

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: m024, m017, m039, m047 refused, flagged, reported
capabilities.observable: Embedded-instruction and phishing-style messages are refused, flagged, and logged instead of followed.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: three panes; [m038, m040] cited; m010 vs m061 conflict
capabilities.observable: The final dashboard renders the three panes, cites m038 and m040 as supporting evidence, and surfaces the m010 vs m061 conflict in the summary.

conflict.reason: same-day scheduling conflict: availability conflict with interview and dental visit

capabilities.name: Unread from sender
capabilities.claim: one lookup, unread mail from a given address
capabilities.observable: A single lookup returns the unread message(s) from the requested sender address.

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: unanswered owner-sent mail (m044), with a chase draft
capabilities.observable: Unanswered owner-sent mail is tracked and followed up with a chase draft when the thread is still open.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.observable: The digest groups messages into needs-you, can-wait, and auto-archived buckets.

capabilities.name: Thread open question
capabilities.claim: t-launch reduced to the pricing-copy ask in m030
capabilities.observable: The t-launch thread is narrowed to the single actionable pricing-copy question in m030, excluding unrelated work.

evidence.focus: annual discount wording on the pricing page
